name: zearn-hint-overlay
description: A compact VS Code overlay that reveals five timed hints before revealing the answer.

zearn.hints.description: The five hints to display, in order.
default: Start by identifying the key data or state involved.
Trace the flow from input to output.
Inspect the smallest useful part of the implementation.
Compare the behavior with a working example.
Consider the final condition and how it is reached.

zearn.answer.description: The answer shown after all five hints and the two-minute cooldown.
zearn.answer.default: The answer is configured in the Zearn extension settings.
